definitions.explanation: Energetic, all-out effort in action. Rarely used alone; appears almost exclusively in the four-character idiom {獅子|しし}{奮迅|ふんじん} (charging like a lion).

examples.japanese: ⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧、⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: He scored a goal with furious energy in the second half of the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: Before the deadline, she finished the materials with the furious energy of a charging lion.

notes:
Almost never appears alone — learn it as part of ⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん} (charging like a lion), a four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) praising someone for working or fighting with overwhelming intensity. Used in sports commentary, news headlines, and admiring descriptions of someone's effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: a lion-like performance
- ⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧: lion-like momentum
- ⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧{奮迅|ふんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧: lion-like effort/work

Formal/literary register; less common in casual conversation than in writing.
